tooltip.arcane_singularity.shard: A crystal shard humming with faint astral energy.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.echo: A halo of the end that still whispers.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.echo2: Insert into the Singularity Cradle to begin the 30 second ritual. One is consumed when the ritual starts.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.terminal: Sneak-use a controller to build the structure. Creative needs no materials.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.terminal2: In survival it places whatever materials you have, and can be reused until complete.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.terminal3: Sneak-left-click a controller (all four kinds) to demolish the whole structure; creative refunds nothing, survival refunds everything.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.codex: An arcane tome containing all knowledge of the armillary and the stargates.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.rod_help: Sneak-right-click a stargate to record it, then sneak-right-click another to pair. Sneak-right-click the same gate to clear.
message.arcane_singularity.partial: Placed %s parts; %s spots still lack materials or are obstructed. Use the terminal again later.
message.arcane_singularity.build_none: Nothing could be placed: targets are occupied or materials are missing.
message.arcane_singularity.build_done: All structure parts are in place.
message.arcane_singularity.build_blocked: Parts placed, but some targets are still obstructed, so the structure cannot form yet.
message.arcane_singularity.blocked: Target position is occupied by %s. Construction cancelled.
message.arcane_singularity.chunk_unloade: Some target chunks are not loaded yet; move closer and use the terminal again to finish.
message.arcane_singularity.forced_close: Stargate force-closed. The other end is losing resonance.
message.arcane_singularity.formed: Armillary formed. Six lasers begin calibration. Any side of the controller accepts a redstone lever.
message.arcane_singularity.gate_formed: Stargate formed. Any side of the controller accepts a redstone lever.
message.arcane_singularity.not_complete: The structure is incomplete and cannot start.
message.arcane_singularity.out_of_world: Target position is outside the world height limit.
message.arcane_singularity.projection: Hologram started for 30 seconds. Aim at a ghost to inspect the required block.
message.arcane_singularity.projection_fo: The structure is already formed; no hologram needed.
message.arcane_singularity.rod_cleared: Cleared the stargate record from the rod.
message.arcane_singularity.rod_corrupt: The record is corrupted. Please bind again.
message.arcane_singularity.rod_same: A stargate cannot pair with itself. Choose another.
message.arcane_singularity.redstone_link: Redstone interface linked: flip the lever on to start, off to stop.
message.arcane_singularity.chunks_kept: Force-loaded %s chunk(s) covering the whole structure: it keeps running when you leave. Break the controller to release them.
message.arcane_singularity.chunks_releas: Controller broken; the structure's force-loaded chunks were released.
message.arcane_singularity.demolished_cr: Structure dismantled (creative mode: no blocks returned).
tooltip.arcane_singularity.beacon: A skyshooting laser tower that bends the flow of time in the whole dimension.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.beacon2: Feed its four ports from a black hole generator; any side takes a redstone lever.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.beacon3: Only one per dimension. Use the formation terminal to fill the tower.
message.arcane_singularity.time_beacon_c: This dimension already has a time beacon. Only one is allowed.
message.arcane_singularity.beacon_formed: Time beacon formed. Connect a black hole generator to begin the one-minute charge.
message.arcane_singularity.time_rate_loc: Only slow and accelerate modes have adjustable rates.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.world_core: The master gate at the centre of the ritual field: it only starts when the black hole generator, the stargate and the time beacon are all online.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.world_core2: Run World Core conduits from the three controllers to the three interfaces, then place a World Core in the slot.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.world_core3: The command field unlocks once the ritual settles. Any side accepts redstone.
tooltip.arcane_singularity.world_core_it: A law of the world bound inside a crystal.
Place it in the World Core slot to make the whole ritual field come alive.
message.arcane_singularity.world_core_fo: World Core formed. Link the three controllers with conduits and insert a World Core.
message.arcane_singularity.world_core_in: Interface links — Black hole: %s, Stargate: %s, Time beacon: %s
message.arcane_singularity.world_core_no: The World Core has not stabilised yet; the command field is still locked.
